text: 5 years ago if you wanted
to add a major feature to
a software project you need an
engineer Someone who could read 1000
lines of code understand the architecture
find the right files make changes
run tests fix errors But today
a developer can open cursor and
simply type " add google authentication
to my application ". And an
AI agent can explore the code
base modify multiple files create new
components run commands and help complete
the task But the interesting question
is not what can cursor do
the interesting question is what architecture
allows an AI system to behave
like a software engineer Because cursor
is not just a chat bot
inside an editor Behind that simple
interface is a collection of systems
working together a code intelligence system
a context engine an AI agent
a tool execution layer a model
orche stration platform and a code
modification pipeline Today we are going
to design the architecture behind an
AI coding agent Let 's start
with the simplest possible design A
developer writes a prompt the system
sends it to an LL M
the LL M returns code something
like this This works for small
questions for example write a python
function to sort a list But
software engineering is different a real
application is not one function it
is thousands of interconnected files The
AI needs to understand where authentication
leaves how APIs are connected what
data schema exists which components depend
on each other a model setting
alone cannot do this So the
architecture needs something more A production
AI coding agent needs multiple systems
At the highest level the key
idea is the LL M is
not the product the LL M
is one component inside a larger
software system The surrounding architecture is
what turns a language model into
an engineer The first layer is
the application developers interact with the
cursor editor This layer is responsible
for understanding the developer 's action
showing AI responses displaying code changes
managing conversation tracking the current workspace
But it also provides something extremely
important context For example which file
is open where is the cursor
what code is selected what error
list what changes happened recently The
IDE is not just a chat
window it is the AI connection
to a developer environment Now it
is the first major engineering challenge
How does an AI understand a
massive code base Imagine a large
compute repository You cannot send this
entire repository to an AI model
So before the AI answers anything
the system builds an understanding of
the code base the architecture The
system analy zes files functions classes
imports dependencies relationships It creates a
map of the software This is
similar to how Google works Google
does not search the entire internet
every time you search It creates
an index first an AI coding
agent needs the same thing It
needs a search engine for your
code Now the system understand the
repository but there is another problem
What information should the AI actually
see Suppose you ask as authentication
your project may have login components
user models database tables API routes
middle ware tests Which file matter
This is the job of the
context engine Think of it as
the AI information filter The context
engine combines current file open tabs
repository search code relationships previous conversation
error messages The goal is simple
Give the model enough information to
solve the problem but not so
much that it becomes slow and
expensive This balance is one of
the hardest problems in AI engineering
Now we reach the core of
the system the agent A normal
chat bot follows this pattern but
software engineering requires a process For
example at Google authentication the agent
needs to find existing authentication logic
understand the architecture create a plan
modify files run tests fix problems
This require an orche stration layer
The agent is constantly asking what
should I do next This is
called the agent loop think act
observe repeat The AI model itself
cannot change your computer It cannot
open files it cannot run commands
it cannot execute tests So the
agent needs tools The model decide
what action should happen the tool
performs the action the results come
back then the model decides the
next step This suppression is what
makes AI agent powerful The model
provides reasoning the tools provide abilities
The final piece is the model
layer an AI coding company cannot
permanently depend on one model Today
best model might be cloud tomorrow
it might be G PT or
Gemini So companies create a model
extraction layer The layer handles routing
cost optimization latency model selection reliability
The AI model becomes irre pl
icable the architecture remains C oding
code is only half the challenge
The system also needs to safely
apply changes The pipeline Instead of
blindly rewriting your project the system
create a patch show exactly what
changed then applies it This is
critical because software change needs trust
So if we put everything together
this is the architecture behind an
AI software engineer The important lesson
is the future of AI application
will not be built by simply
connecting a chat bot to an
interface The winning system will combine
models retrieval planning tools memory execution
and feedback loops C ursor is
not powerful because it has access
to an LL M It is
powerful because it built an entire
engineering system around that LL M
And the architecture is not unique
to cursor cloud code GitHub cop
ilot agent wind sur f open
AI cod ex all of these
systems are moving towards the same
idea AI is no longer just
answering questions It is becoming an
active participant in the software development
process In the next video we
'll break down another AI engineering
system and see how different companies
are solving the same problem with
different architecture Thank you for watching
this video See you in the
next one
